subtype: Approach: adding a note about changes to the plan [Revision]
passage:
Chandrika: Chetta, look at the chart. See the yellow square on Wednesday?
Jomon: A note that says PT shoes. Why the note?
Chandrika: Last week I sat out PT. The timetable had changed and my chart still showed the old one. I felt so silly on that bench.
Jomon: So the note will fix it?
Chandrika: The note is for Wednesday. But changes can come any week, so on Sunday evenings I read the school diary before I pack.
Jomon: And if the note falls off?
Chandrika: Then the Sunday check catches it. Two ways, so I won't get caught again.
Jomon: Smart plan, little sister. I will ask you before my next test.

qa.q: What does the note on Chandrika's chart say?
qa.a: The note says PT shoes, and it sits on the Wednesday square.

qa.q: How did Chandrika feel when sitting out PT last week?
qa.a: Chandrika felt silly and disappointed, which is why the mistake must not happen again.

qa.q: What other approach could Chandrika use, and why?
qa.a: Chandrika could ask a classmate to tell Chandrika about timetable changes, since a friend may hear news first. A short list at the door could also catch missing items.

qa.q: How does Jomon see the plan?
qa.a: Jomon finds it smart; asking what happens if the note falls off shows Jomon is testing the plan and is happy to see two ways to catch a change.

grounding: After the PT shoe mistake, Chandrika adds a note to the chart and reads the diary on Sundays for changes.

subtype: Approach: adding a note about changes to the plan [Revision]
passage: The week I missed PT because of my black shoes still stings a little. Sitting on that bench, I worked out what went wrong: my chart said nothing about PT, and I never looked at the diary. So that evening I wrote on a yellow sticky note, 'WEDNESDAY: PT SHOES!', and stuck it right on Wednesday's column. Then I made a Sunday rule: before dinner, I read the school diary for any change and fix the chart. Two Sundays later, the diary said library day had moved to Friday. I changed it. My little brother Samir laughed. 'Aditi didi, you're the timetable police.' Maybe. But I haven't sat on that bench since.

qa.q: What did Aditi write on the sticky note?
How does Aditi still feel about the missed PT week?
qa.a: It still stings a little, so Aditi felt embarrassed and left out, which pushed her to change the plan.

qa.q: What made Aditi's fix better than just trying to remember?
qa.a: The Sunday diary check catches new changes, like library day moving, and the note keeps them in front of her.

qa.q: How does Samir see Aditi's Sunday rule?
qa.a: Samir finds it funny and calls her the timetable police, even though it works.

grounding: Shows a girl who, after the PT shoe mistake, adds a sticky note for Wednesday PT to her chart and checks the diary every Sunday for changes.

subtype: Approach: adding a note about changes to the plan [Revision]
passage: Class teacher's note, 5B. Two weeks ago Rekha sat out PT for coming without white shoes; she had packed from the old timetable. I didn't scold her; she was upset enough. This week she showed me her timetable chart, now with a pink sticky note on Wednesday: 'PT shoes'. And now, she told me, she reads the school diary every Sunday evening with her mother and updates the chart. Ritu, her friend, has copied the sticky-note idea. Rekha has been on the field every Wednesday since. I've asked her to show her chart at Friday assembly.

qa.q: What colour was the sticky note on Wednesday?
How did Rekha feel after sitting out PT?
qa.a: The note says she was upset enough, so she likely felt disappointed and embarrassed about missing PT.

qa.q: Why does Rekha's Sunday diary check matter as much as the sticky note?
qa.a: The note covers the change she already knows about, while the Sunday check catches the next change before it trips her up.

qa.q: How does the note-writer see Rekha's fix?
qa.a: The note-writer is impressed enough to ask Rekha to show her chart at Friday assembly.

grounding: Illustrates a girl who, after missing PT, adds a sticky note for Wednesday PT shoes and checks the diary each Sunday for timetable changes.
